prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return CommonJS module solution.js.
Required API: exports.uniqueSortedSquares = function(input)
Behavior: Parse a non-empty comma-separated list of canonical signed decimal integers in -1000..1000. Square every value, remove duplicates, sort increasing, and return comma-separated decimal values. Reject malformed or out-of-range input.
Visible example: -3,2,3,0,-2 returns 0,4,9.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const nums=s=>{if(!s)return null;let o=[];for(const z of s.split(',')){if(!/^(?:0|-?[1-9][0-9]*)$/.test(z))return null;let x=Number(z);if(x< -1000||x>1000)return null;o.push(x)}return o};exports.uniqueSortedSquares=function(s){let a=nums(s);if(!a)return null;return[...new Set(a.map(x=>x*x))].sort((x,y)=>x-y).join(',')}
